notes.title: Hotfix: Resolved Crash Issue When Minimizing the Window on Windows
notes.content: We have released a hotfix for our game to address a specific issue affecting Windows users. This update (version 2.1.1) fixes a bug that caused the game to crash when the window was minimized. We appreciate your patience and feedback, which helped us identify and fix this problem. Please update your game to benefit from this fix. If you continue to experience issues or have any suggestions, feel free to contact our support team. Thank you for your support and happy gaming!

notes.title: Celestwald Update 2.1: Bug Fixes and Linux Availability!
notes.content:
[b]Celestwald Update: Bug Fixes and Linux Availability![/b]

[b]Adventurers of Celestwald,[/b]

Get ready to explore new lands and embark on even more thrilling adventures! A new Celestwald update is now available, bringing along a host of fixes and improvements.

[b]Bug Fix:[/b]

An issue preventing players from properly entering the home of the alchemist Theo has been resolved. You can now visit him without any hindrance and uncover his secrets.

[b]New Platform:[/b]

Great news for Linux players! Celestwald is now available on your preferred operating system. You can download the game right away and set out to conquer the enchanted world of Celestwald.

Don't wait any longer—download the update today to enjoy all these new features!

If you're stuck in quests, feel free to watch Celestwald's help videos here: [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJTpL2XGpSLXh8g2Mbm30H11QiWF7j4jS]Solution Playlist[/url]

Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!

The Celestwald Team
